name: design-first-frontend
description: Skill-only Codex plugin for evidence-based multi-surface frontend redesign and verification.

interface.longDescription: Design-First Frontend maps routes, views, modes, states, and breakpoints into a coverage-driven artifact set, then implements and verifies the real product against its visual, interaction, and engineering contract.
defaultPrompt: Use design-first frontend to redesign this multi-page product as a coherent production experience.
Map the route/view/state coverage, create the required artifact set, then implement and verify every scoped surface.
